design_description: A clean and elegant Brazil-inspired design built around a crisp white base with deep green accents on the collar, sleeve cuffs, and branding. The jersey uses a subtle tonal brushstroke texture across the fabric, adding depth and movement while keeping the overall look minimal and refined. The centered memorial sponsor layout gives the shirt a ceremonial, almost heritage-inspired feel, reinforced by the understated crown graphic and balanced typography. Overall, the kit feels classic, respectful, and premium — combining Brazilian identity with a modern minimalist execution.
